summary: Constructor-style initializer on a session object. Runs a fixed 48-iteration loop writing -1 into dword pairs across a contiguous span of the object (each iteration stores -1 at the dword 48 positions below the running pointer and at the running pointer, then advances it by one dword). Then explicitly zeroes this+0x198, this+0x19C, this+0x1A0 and this+0x1A8, writes -1 to this+0x1AC, zeroes the byte at this+0x1B0, and returns 0. No reads, no globals, no calls.

do/while loop run exactly 48 times: each iteration writes -1 to the dword at (v1 - 48) and to the dword at v1, advances v1 by one dword, and decrements v2 until it reaches 0. Collectively the writes fill a contiguous dword span of the object with -1.
*(this + 428) = -1; write -1 to this+0x1AC (the init literal listed in the packet as 18446744073709551615, i.e. the -1 marker).
